basic_info.description: This stunning corner unit loft at the Oriental Warehouse includes original exposed brick walls, timber beams, and pine flooring showcase the building's industrial heritage while modern updates provide contemporary comfort. The multi-level open floor plan features soaring ceilings, a gourmet kitchen with stone countertops, and dramatic architectural staircases connecting the living spaces. The main level offers a striking living area while the upper level provides tranquil bedroom retreats with abundant natural light from skylights. Thoughtfully renovated bathrooms blend industrial elements with luxury finishes. The artistic interplay of exposed brick, warm wood, and crisp white surfaces creates a sophisticated aesthetic throughout. This rare offering includes two parking spaces with a high-speed EV charger and dedicated storage - coveted amenities in urban living. After 22 years with the same owner, this iconic warehouse conversion represents an extraordinary opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco architectural history. Located 1 block from the Embarcadero Waterfront, close to Ferry Building Plaza, Farmers Market, Oracle Park (Giants), Chase Center (Warriors), Caltrain, shops, world-class restaurants and close to all forms of transportation.
